newsitem.title: USA: AAR Q1 EPS up on rise in revenues.
newsitem.headline: AAR Q1 EPS up on rise in revenues.

text.p: AAR Corp said Monday a rise in earnings for the first quarter reflects increased revenues from all three areas of its business.

"We accomplished the substantial growth while continuing to generate cash from operations through an ongoing focus on asset management; at quarter's end the company's balance sheet remained very strong," chairman Ira Eichner said in a statement.
Earlier, AAR reported first quarter earnings of $0.30 a share, up from $0.20. Sales for the quarter were a record $136.0 million, up from $109.6 million.
AAR supplies aerospace and aviation products and services.
